accepted_revision.role: Prior-work contribution comparison only; no observations imported into fitting, scoring or precision inputs

hindsight: Per application/workload/threshold scenario best observed configuration, reference only; no fit/selection access

policy.joint: Use the unchanged development-trained feasibility model; joint may retain the informed query-only action under the frozen 0.05 predicted-score margin
policy.margin_role: Engineering switching criterion; five percentage points of predicted finite-workload feasibility, not user-experience importance
policy.profile_fixed: One query/rendering choice per application/threshold scenario from the same permitted profile budget; fixed across loaded workload contexts
policy.query_only: Query may vary with workload and threshold scenario; rendering fixed within application/scenario from permitted development/profile information

precision.basis: User-accepted fixed twenty-date budget; no measured between-day development variance or guaranteed power
precision.inconclusive: Report insufficient precision or unsupported assumptions without extending collection
precision.margin_units: absolute standardized feasibility coverage; distinct from model prediction abstention
precision.missing_components: Keep original calendar/application weights and report identification bounds; no replacement or successful-day renormalization
precision.population_claims: Conditional paired-day t interval only with complete dates and positive variance under its stated assumptions; bounded independent-day sensitivities reported separately
precision.zero_variance: No point-width population t interval; separately labelled bounded independent-day sensitivities remain available

primary_contrast: day-aggregated joint minus query_only standardized feasibility score
primary_question: Does joint configuration selection improve standardized joint-feasibility coverage over an informed query-only baseline on reserved application tasks?

semantics.browser_clock: Audited navigation-relative critical-content paint; only healthy, on-time/window-qualified probes count as completed
semantics.browser_endpoint: Content-matched critical initial paint plus trusted reservation/cancellation or sale/refund completion; three landmarks and a four-second whole-task cap
semantics.integrity: Invalid semantic/clock/source/route/CPU evidence stops scoring; valid performance failures score against the selected configuration
semantics.logical_denominator: All offered operations, separately read/write_a/write_b; all failures, drops and censored records miss deadlines
semantics.population_reliability: No per-request independent-Bernoulli certification is inferred from finite workload scores
semantics.read_clock: complete_s minus intended_s, including dispatch lag

status: frozen prospective main contract; acquisition still requires the actual release and planned-date checks

threshold_family.role: development-chosen engineering sensitivity inputs; no claimed production or perceptual SLO

weights: Equal application weights, equal physical workload contexts within application, equal threshold scenarios within context; aggregate all matched panels in a UTC collection-day block
